I’m being pretty picky on specs because I plan to keep it for years. I’m looking for a 2017–2024 Toyota RAV4 as my next suv within 30 miles of Spring Valley, NV, and I want it between $39,000 and $45,000 with under 40,000 miles; owners not a major concern. It should be plug_in_hybrid with a automatic transmission and fwd drivetrain, and it needs to fit seating for 6, no kids, no pets. Primary use cases are family, work, budget_value, so cargo is low priority and my maintenance priority is low cost. Must-haves: remote start, heated seats, android auto, blind spot monitoring, lane departure warning. Nice-to-haves: lane keep assist, built in navigation. Please avoid: heated steering wheel, ventilated seats, third row seating. I prefer gray exterior, and I’m explicitly not shopping for hatchback body styles.
